Full summary: Releasing 2.7.0: live smoke ALL PASS against the built server (record/resolve/cursor/housekeeping-defaults/compound-scope-staleness/tombstone/unarchive end-to-end); cutting plugin 1.25.0 + server 2.7.0, tag push to CI
Decisions: Chose plugin minor bump 1.25.0 alongside server 2.7.0 in the same version commit — plugin/BEHAVIORS.md and the bundled server change together, and the CI plugin-version-check requires the bump with any plugin/ change
Findings: Live smoke must run from inside the repo tree (bare-specifier SDK imports resolve from the script path, not cwd) — scratchpad scripts importing repo deps need a temp copy in the repo root; need: after the 2.7.0 release lands, update the local plugin install in BOTH user and project scopes (stale project pin shadows user scope) and notify the field repo to upgrade + delete their interim-guidance CLAUDE.md section
